comparison_notes: The preceding learned-from-one orders moved near two without establishing convergence. This is a fresh exploratory follow-up, not confirmation that two is optimal or that long memory is useful.

All four arms have independent zero local/history feature gates and start at identity. Ordinary lag2 has 1536 total/trainable parameters, fixed-two GL has 1537 total/1536 trainable, and learned GL has 1537 trainable parameters. The frozen no-adapter model is the shared zero-update baseline.

lag2 uses ordinary Torch h[t]=-2*x[t-1]+x[t-2], with missing taps zero. Float64 intermediate accumulation matches the Rust map before its float32 output boundary. At alpha=2 and step=1, Rust strictly-past GL is the same map; fixed-two versus lag2 tests implementation parity, not independent quality evidence.

Require exact same-math per-step losses, common gate-gradient receipts, development scores, final gates/named Adam state and per-block endpoints for this CPU-f32 protocol. Preserve a mismatch as a failed parity criterion, not a quality advantage.

Learned-two starts at alpha=2 but retains all Rust order derivatives, including older taps whose forward coefficients vanish at the integer. Learned-one reruns the previous recipe from scratch with the current frozen runtime; historical endpoints are not pooled as independent repetitions.

Primary contrasts: fixed-two minus lag2 for parity; learned-two minus fixed-two for learnable departure from the two-tap filter; learned-one minus learned-two for initialization; learned-one minus lag2 for the preceding learned recipe against the short filter.

Complete all twelve 512-update runs and 24 continuation-only updates before endpoint evaluation. Development does not select checkpoints, hyperparameters, duration or the reported arm. Preserve losing outcomes and report moving orders without claiming convergence.

Pride/Alice are reused exploratory endpoints, potentially in pretraining, not untouched confirmation. Seeds vary paired minibatch order, not independently acquired corpora. No unique fractional-memory, significance or general-LLM claim follows from a small quality difference.

CPU float32 interfaces, frozen local GPT-2, complete unpadded contexts, no KV cache or packed documents. History resets at each 128-token block. All arms retain the shared K=32 budget; the ordinary map uses two past taps. Training wall time is not a same-math performance benchmark.
